title: Most Brilliant Starry Sky
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ stars on the $xy$-plane. The $i$-th star is represented as the point with coordinates $(X_i,Y_i)$.

Draw one line that passes through the origin and does not pass through any star, and choose one of the two regions into which the line divides the plane.

Find the maximum possible number of stars contained in the chosen region.

You are given $T$ test cases; solve each of them.

## Constraints

- $1 \le T \le 2 \times 10^5$
- $1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5$
- The sum of $N$ over all test cases is at most $2 \times 10^5$.
- $-10^9 \le X_i,Y_i \le 10^9$
- $(X_i,Y_i) \ne (0,0)$
- $(X_i,Y_i) \ne (X_j, Y_j) ~ (i \ne j)$
- No two distinct stars are collinear with the origin.
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
T
\mathrm{case}_1
\mathrm{case}_2
\vdots
\mathrm{case}_T
```

Each test case is given in the following format:

```
N
X_1 Y_1
X_2 Y_2
\vdots
X_N Y_N
```

## Output

Print $T$ lines. The $i$-th line should contain the answer for the $i$-th test case.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

$xy$ 平面上有 $N$ 颗星星。第 $i$ 颗星星表示为坐标为 $(X_i,Y_i)$ 的点。

画一条经过原点且不经过任何星星的直线，并选择这条直线将平面分成的两个区域之一。

求所选区域中星星数量的最大可能值。

给定 $T$ 组测试用例，请分别求解。

## 约束条件

- $1 \le T \le 2 \times 10^5$
- $1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5$
- 所有测试用例中 $N$ 的总和不超过 $2 \times 10^5$。
- $-10^9 \le X_i,Y_i \le 10^9$
- $(X_i,Y_i) \ne (0,0)$
- $(X_i,Y_i) \ne (X_j, Y_j) ~ (i \ne j)$
- 任意两颗不同的星星都不与原点共线。
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
T
\mathrm{case}_1
\mathrm{case}_2
\vdots
\mathrm{case}_T
```

每组测试用例按以下格式给出：

```
N
X_1 Y_1
X_2 Y_2
\vdots
X_N Y_N
```

## 输出格式

输出 $T$ 行。第 $i$ 行应包含第 $i$ 组测试用例的答案。

samples.note:
In the $1$-st test case, if you draw the line $y=-x$ and choose the region containing the $1$-st star, that region contains the $1$-st, $2$-nd, and $3$-rd stars. It is impossible to include all $4$ stars, so the answer is $3$.

In the $2$-nd test case, if you draw the line $x=0$ and choose the region to its right, all stars are contained.
